caption:
There is something inside you that has watched every thought you've ever had — and it has never once spoken.

Right now — can you feel the one who is reading these words? That is the Witness. Comment 'I see it' if you felt it just now, or 'not yet' if you're still searching. That is one part of you now named. There are others still hidden — follow Gods of the Mind and we'll meet every one of them, until you see the whole of yourself.
